chrysa-project-init — technical digest
=====================================

`project-init` rationalizes project creation, enforces standards from day one, and automates the repetitive setup work that every new repository needs.

## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
examples/perfect_api_view.py — EXAMPLE — canonical pattern, copy & adapt.
examples/perfect_repository.py — EXAMPLE — canonical pattern, copy & adapt.
examples/perfect_schema.py — EXAMPLE — canonical pattern, copy & adapt.
examples/perfect_serializer.py — EXAMPLE — canonical pattern, copy & adapt.
examples/perfect_service.py — EXAMPLE — canonical pattern, copy & adapt.
examples/perfect_viewset.py — EXAMPLE — canonical pattern, copy & adapt.
scripts/quality_gate.py
scripts/sync_standards_domains.py — Generate ``profiles/domains.yaml`` from the shared-standards domain registry.
src/project_init/__init__.py — project-init — orchestrator that scaffolds chrysa repos from shared tools.
src/project_init/cli.py — `project-init` command surface (typer).
src/project_init/forge_adapter.py — Adapter over the `fastapi-app-generator` engine (the forge).
src/project_init/manifest.py — The `.project-init.yaml` manifest — the canonical record of what a repo opted into.
src/project_init/standards_domain.py — A single `STD-*` governance domain — a pointer into shared-standards.
src/project_init/standards_profile.py — One inheritable standards profile as declared in YAML.
src/project_init/standards_profile_resolver.py — Resolve an inheritable standards profile to its applicable `STD-*` domains.
tests/__init__.py
tests/test_forge_adapter.py — Tests for the FastAPI forge adapter — wiring only, the forge itself is mocked.
tests/test_manifest.py — Tests for the ProjectManifest — the standards_profile field wiring.
tests/test_quality_gate.py — Tests for the shared quality gate — parse/compare helpers.
tests/test_standards_profile_resolver.py — Tests for the standards profile resolver against the canonical YAML data.
tests/test_sync_standards_domains.py — Tests for the domains-registry generator (scripts/sync_standards_domains.py).
